name: Pet boarding and doggy daycare

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Stay in a standard run (2 nights)
services.story: The main story: Juniper's 2 nights in a standard run, $96. A card is saved for the inn's $20 fee (a no-show, or a cancel within 24 hours). Alex pays at pick-up.

services.name: Stay in a suite (2 nights)
services.story: 2 nights in a suite, $140. Suites and holiday stays take a $40 deposit when booking; the $100 rest is paid at pick-up.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Nico and Eli (drivers and kennel staff)

services.name: Stay with van rides (2 nights)
services.story: The main story: 2 nights in a standard run with van rides both ways, $170. A card is saved, and charged $170 when Nico brings Juniper home and texts DONE.

services.name: Suite stay with van rides (2 nights)
services.story: 2 nights in a suite with van rides, $220. A $40 deposit when booking; the $180 rest is charged to the saved card at DONE.

Breed and size, and spayed or neutered
Has the dog stayed or played off leash with other dogs before?
Any extras, like a bath before going home
safety_stop: a pet that's hurt, bleeding, or very sick now
a pet that ate something poisonous
a person hurt, or in danger
license: if: where the state licenses or registers boarding kennels or dog daycares; elsewhere the business registration only. Decided state by state from the state's form
